Game Overview

In Ghost Float, the core idea is straightforward: navigate a spectral sky in Ghost Float, a thrilling airborne adventure. Tap to ascend and master your rhythm to dodge dynamic obstacles. Collect boosters to enhance your score and prolong your ethereal journey. Timing is key as you float higher into the mysterious horizon for endless, addictive fun.
